QUOTE: Dynamic checks are opt-in and off by default: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` (clang MSan) and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` (memcheck). They are commented out in `mbedtls_config.h:2123` and `:2142`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the MSan/valgrind checks are opt-in and off by default, but it never says the facility is explicitly not part of the library API, so one atomic part of the item is missing.
